_comment: Go-vs-Python parity for defaults carriers that are SYMLINKS (#1674 round 2).
Each tree is built in a temp dir by BOTH sides: Go asserts pkg/config
ResolveEffective's merged_hash (the exporter's chain rule), Python asserts
describe_tenant's. Neither reads the other's source; both assert this table.
The carrier belongs to the directory that HOLDS THE ENTRY (Go's WalkDir never
follows a link), whatever the link points at. Measured on main 531286eb:
t1's root tenant got Python chain [] vs Go [_defaults.yaml]; after the first
#1674 commit t2's sub tenant got Python ['sub/_defaults.yaml'] (08c2671b...)
chain_len is compared, not chain strings: Go reports the link path, Python
the resolved path, by long-standing design of each tool.
